# Channel Performance Review

## Context
- Channel and period:
- Objective:
- Audience:
- Spend and resource level:

## Performance
| Metric | Baseline | Target | Actual | Variance | Interpretation |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|

## Diagnosis
Review audience quality, reach, frequency, creative, landing experience, conversion, tracking, and external conditions.

## Decision
Continue, optimize, test, scale, reduce, or stop. State the evidence, expected effect, owner, and next review date. Include limitations and avoid attributing all observed change to the channel.
